top.line: To create one repository and one DNS record, the site factory's pipeline holds power over the whole organisation.
top.para: Pipelines now need behaviour policies, like agents.

in-short.line: A small job, a large grant, no scale limits, changing code, and a policy for the pipeline.

grant.line: The GitHub App token covers every repository: administration, contents and workflows, including delete.
grant.para: No long-lived keys, but far more power than the job needs.

scale.line: Nothing limits how many repositories or DNS records; the role may point any subdomain anywhere.
scale.para: IAM can limit names and types, not targets.

excuse.line: We got away with it because pipeline code did not change; here requests arrive as pull requests.
excuse.para: A merged change to the workflow would inherit the whole grant.

policy.line: Each capability with a reach, an undo class, a limit and a boundary outside the grant.
policy.para: Brokers, narrowed tokens, and protection on .github/.

why.line: Agents now drive pipelines; the credentials did not shrink and the code stopped being fixed.
why.para: The gap RiskMandate exists to close.

limits.line: Nothing exploited; reviewer and branch settings unchecked; the limits are proposals.

sources.line: The factory's docs, workflow and board, and abp.sgit.ai.
